translations.web: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
translations.bsb: These were the portions Moses had given them on the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho.
translations.kjv: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
